verifies.G113-C8: newDataType of modifyDataType is set to a typed length form varchar(40) after the length is asked. Only char and varchar take a length; decimal precision syntax is not offered. The other two tags are not exercised.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<databaseChangeLog xmlns="http://www.liquibase.org/xml/ns/dbchangelog">
    <changeSet id="1" author="a" context="dev" labels="v1,v2">
        <createTable tableName="note">
            <column name="id" type="int"/>
        </createTable>
        <createSequence sequenceName="note_seq"/>
    </changeSet>
    <changeSet id="2" author="a">
        <preConditions onFail="HALT"><tableExists tableName="note"/></preConditions>
        <modifyDataType tableName="note" columnName="id" newDataType="bigint"/>
    </changeSet>
</databaseChangeLog>
